plaatsen.tekst: And Isaac said unto Jacob, Come near, I pray thee, that I may feel thee, my son, whether thou be my very son Esau
And Samson said unto the lad that held him by the hand, Suffer me that I may feel the pillars whereupon the house standeth, that I may lean
They have hands, but they handle not: feet have they, but they walk not: neither speak they through their throat.
